ai_summary: Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited reported a marginal profit of 48.37 lakhs for Q3 2026, despite an alarming 90% sequential decline in revenue from operations to 288.26 lakhs. This profitability was achieved by an almost complete cessation of material purchases and significant expense reductions, raising concerns about the sustainability of its core business operations. Material impacts include a substantial reclassification of Property, Plant, and Equipment to assets held for sale and a large equity capital increase, collectively indicating a major operational restructuring or potential divestment.
